title: Bounded decoding edge value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let each vertex be assigned a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^q$ taking values in $[-1,1]$, and let $\\varepsilon\\in\\mathbb R$, a default symbol in $\\mathrm{Fin}(q)$, a vertex $v$, and a neighbor of $v$ be given. The bounded decoding edge value is the candidate-decoding edge value at that vertex and neighbor, using the candidates produced from this table and $\\varepsilon$ and the specified default symbol.
